source: public.boundaries — ST_Area(polygon::geography)/4046.86, geo_type='neighborhood'. Refresh via the SQL in scripts/check-boundary-sanity.mjs.
_comment: A community/master-planned 'neighborhood' boundary above thresholdAcres is almost certainly an un-corrected polygon (see Tetherow's 5,718ac->699ac correction). Oversized boundaries make the subdivisions list, the map shape, the in-boundary listings, and the counts all wrong. ci:boundary-sanity fails when a boundary here exceeds the threshold and is neither verified nor listed as awaiting correction in boundary-sanity-baseline.json. Correct a boundary to its authoritative county plat, refresh this file, then move it out of `allowed`. Refreshed 2026-09-25 after the 2026-08-23 plat rebuilds, the Widgi Creek / Inn of the 7th Mountain split (migration 20260925031047) and the Black Butte Ranch Country House condominium (migration 20260925033420); the previous refresh was 2026-06-14.
